items.label: Table 1, the 13 in silico networks and their sizes
Table 2, AUPR of GeCON, ARACNE, CLR and MRNET on D1 to D13

cause.summary: GeCON as the paper describes it ranks pairs no better than chance on these data (mean AUPR 0.203, the share of true pairs is 0.203; mean AUROC 0.485), while minet's methods reach AUPR 0.275 to 0.291 and AUROC 0.535 to 0.61. At theta 0.5 and tau 20 it connects 84% to 100% of all pairs, because on positive values almost every edge angle of Eq. (5) sits near 45 or 135 degrees. No variant we tried brings GeCON's mean scores near the paper's (best mean AUPR 0.255 against 0.633); the few single cells that fall within printed precision are not counted as agreement. The comparators' values differ too, so the authors' simulations and scoring cannot be recovered.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Our DREAM3 simulation (the GNW port) differs from the authors' data
hypotheses.test: Compare on D9 to D13, the DREAM4 challenge's own released data, which need no simulation

GeCON was scored as its thresholded network (one point), not by its supports

items.label: Table 3, gene and sample counts of the real datasets

cause.summary: The public files have 17 conditions for Yeast KY and the cell cycle set, not 18, and GEO's GDS825 has 4 samples, not 8. The sporulation file (TLS failure from our runner, no reachable archive) and the 517-gene Arabidopsis matrix could not be obtained, so they have no field. The subset sizes of GDS958 and GDS3702 are our filter's.

assumptions.what: Genes standardised, tau 20, theta 0.8; a module is a connected component of 5 genes or more
assumptions.sensitivity: theta 0.7 finds 2 of the 10 terms, 0.8 finds 4, 0.9 finds 4 (enrich.json)

assumptions.what: Gene filters: the most variable probes of GDS3702 (3000) and GDS958 (4000), one per symbol; Yeast KY is the site's normalised file
assumptions.sensitivity: The paper states only the counts

assumptions.what: A local hypergeometric test on GO release 2026-08-05 in place of GeneMANIA's 2014 service; a term counts when Q < 0.05 in one of our modules
assumptions.sensitivity: Compares in kind only; the paper's Q values and interaction percentages are not recomputed

cause.summary: Terms not found in our modules: GeneMANIA's and FuncAssociate's 2014 annotations and the authors' modules are gone, and our module cut and filters are guesses. Rows of Sporulation, Thaliana are left out: the sporulation file failed TLS verification from our runner and no archive was reachable, and the 517 x 13 Arabidopsis matrix was not located.

cause.summary: Over all 16 steps GeCON finds YBL006W positively, not negatively, related to the other two (positive support 0.69, negative 0.31); the inversion the text describes holds only at some steps, which the paper calls mixed regulation in the same paragraph.

items.label: GeCON "is insensitive to normalization of data" (Methods, advantage iv)

cause.summary: Eq. (5) applies atan2 to the two raw values, so the angle depends on their ratio, not their difference. On Yeast KY's log values (around 7) almost every angle sits near 45 or 135 degrees and GeCON connects all 27,966 pairs; on the site's normalised version of the same genes it connects 1,226 (tau 20, theta 0.6). 97% of the log data's angles lie within 5 degrees of 45 or 135.
